concept_universe.note: concept ids are FMA identifiers as used by BodyParts3D 4.0 (FMA 3.0 build-up per OBJ headers)

kind_definitions.exact-class: concept denotes exactly this bone, incl. laterality/level/digit specificity in the concept name
kind_definitions.class+side: only the un-sided class concept exists; side carried in side_recorded
kind_definitions.class+level: only the regional class concept exists for a vertebra; level carried in level
kind_definitions.part-of-composite: concept exists only in the PART-OF tree; geometry = composition of its part meshes
kind_definitions.NOT-FOUND: no concept in either tree; established by exhaustive stem search, never force-matched
